newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate climbs, baht steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate climbs, baht steady late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate rose to 9.50 percent in late trade on Tuesday from 8.50-9.00 in the morning on tight liquidity resulting from recent heavy buying of the dollar by investors, dealers said.
"The upward trend of the interbank rate is likely to continue tomorrow. Some banks may borrow funds in preparation for the holiday on Thursday," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Thursday is a public holiday due to the King's birthday.
The baht was steady at 25.568-25.573 to the dollar late from 25.570-25.573 in early morning, dealers said.
